findingsAndRevisions: Retrieved degrees/radians and right-triangle ratios explicitly rather than assuming OU Unit4 was already taught.

Kept 3D horizontal projection length distinct from full magnitude and included a non-uniqueness question.
Preserved full derivation while splitting long calculations into meaningful aligned steps.
